description: This file declares functions related to sparse matrix operations in the ATen library, specifically for compressed row storage (CSR) format for sparse matrices. It includes function declarations for matrix multiplication, addition, and solving linear systems, mostly for CPU implementation.

methods.name: _compressed_row_strided_mm_out
methods.description: Performs a matrix multiplication for sparse compressed row matrices with strided dense tensors, returning the result in the provided output tensor.

methods.name: _compressed_row_strided_addmm_out
methods.description: Performs an add-mult operation involving sparse or dense tensors and stores the result in the provided tensor.

methods.name: addmv_out_sparse_csr
methods.description: Computes a matrix-vector product with a sparse CSR matrix and adds to an existing tensor.

methods.name: add_out_sparse_csr
methods.description: Adds two sparse CSR matrices and stores the result in the provided tensor.

methods.name: triangular_solve_out_sparse_csr
methods.description: Solves a triangular linear system with a sparse CSR matrix.
